title: DS Component Change Spec
description: The confirmed intent for a single change to an existing design-system component. classification_candidate is filled by the skill (Step 2) and confirmed by a human at the classification gate; it is never a final classification. version 1.0.

change_type.description: The kind of change. Drives the default classification_candidate (SKILL.md Step 2).

target.description: The prop, variant, or variable the change applies to (e.g. fullWidth, or a token name).

from.description: The current value, name, or type. Required for prop_rename, prop_type_change, and variable_value; absent or null for a variant_add (no prior state).

to.description: The intended value, name, or type. Required for prop_rename, prop_type_change, and variable_value; absent or null for a variant_remove (no successor state).

reason.description: The human's stated reason for the change. A judgment slot, not a mechanical field; the rubric never derives it.

classification_candidate.description: Filled by the skill (Step 2) as a CANDIDATE, null on intake. Never a final classification; a human confirms it at the classification gate.

figma_node_id.description: The component-set or variable node id in the target Figma file, read via the served library maps.

code_source.description: The component source path in the frontend repo.

allOf.$comment: A rename, a type change, or a value change carries both a from and a to.
A variant_add carries a to (the new variant); from may be absent or null.
A variant_remove carries a from (the removed variant); to may be absent or null.
